title: 第七章 当狗第八章 别样感受
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 次日一早，季南北唤出系统界面，选择夺舍功能，目标萧京溪。
昨天季南北几乎没怎么修炼，倒不是偷懒，主要相比起来，本体修行进度实在太慢了。
在萧京溪那儿体验过《仙灵典》后，季南北大致摸清了这套功法的灵气汇聚法门，如果潜心钻研，倒也能在本体上复现出来。
不过那恐怕得耗上数月甚至数年光阴。
而季南北估摸着，再去萧京溪那儿蹭个一两回，自己也就掌握得差不多了。
没办法，金丹期的修为体验实在太诱人了啊!所以本体与其慢慢磨进度，不如干脆好好休整，养足精神。
[夺舍已启动，正在载入修为及天赋数据，请稍候......]
【载入完成!】
熟悉的系统界面浮现，季南北感觉眼前的黑暗逐渐褪去。
萧京溪的闺房再次出现在视野中。
“你又来啦!”
对于季南北的出现，少女不仅没有抵触，反而显得很高兴。
季南北舒展了一下四肢，略微适应这副身躯，随后应道：
“我又来了，你不该紧张一下吗?说不定以后这身子就归我占着了哦。“
“真的吗?那你以后会常来吗?太好了!“季南北揉了揉额角，他还是搞不懂这姑娘奇特的脑回路。
“今天也要修炼吗?“
少女询问道。
季南北应了一声。
不过此时，房门却被轻轻叩响了。
三下轻叩之后，门外便安静等候，显得十分守礼。
季南北微微皱眉，低声问萧京溪。
“应该是侍女。快到仙灵剑宗用早膳的时辰了，大概是来请我去用膳的。“
季南北听了，略感意外。
萧京溪都金丹巅峰了，还需要吃饭吗?
“早膳?你不是应该早就辟谷了吗?““因为早膳用的材料，都是宗门长辈猎取的珍稀妖兽，或是宗门培育的灵植灵物，吃了对修为增长有益处。”
季南北暗暗咂舌。
这哪是吃早饭啊，分明是给门下弟子氪金升级啊!
万恶的有钱人!
可恶，眼泪怎么不自觉从嘴角流下来了。
“进来吧。“
用萧京溪那清冷的嗓音回应后，一名女子推门而入。
“小姐，早膳时辰到了。宗主吩咐，今日请您前往太玄殿用膳，顺便见见青莲剑尊的高徒。“
content_en:
Early the next morning, Ji Nanbei called up the system interface, selected the body seizing function, and targeted Xiao Jingxi.
Ji Nanbei hardly practiced yesterday, not because he was lazy, but mainly because the progress of his body cultivation was too slow in comparison.
After experiencing the "Fairy Spirit Canon" at Xiao Jingxi's place, Ji Nanbei roughly understood the spiritual energy gathering method of this set of exercises. If he studied it with concentration, he could reproduce it on his body.
But that might take months or even years.
And Ji Nanbei estimated that if he went to Xiao Jingxi's place once or twice, he would have a good grasp of it.
There is no way, the experience of cultivation in the golden elixir stage is too tempting! So instead of slowly grinding the progress, it is better to take a good rest and recuperate the spirit.
[Seize the body has been started, loading cultivation and talent data, please wait...]
【Loading completed!】
The familiar system interface emerged, and Ji Nanbei felt the darkness in front of his eyes gradually fade away.
Xiao Jingxi's boudoir appeared in sight again.
"You're here again!"
Not only did the girl not resist Ji Nanbei's appearance, she actually seemed very happy.
Ji Nanbei stretched his limbs, slightly adapted to this body, and then responded:
"I'm here again, shouldn't you be nervous? Maybe this body will be mine from now on."
"Really? Will you come here often in the future? Great!" Ji Nanbei rubbed his forehead. He still couldn't understand this girl's strange brain circuit.
"Do you want to practice today too?"
the girl asked.
Ji Nanbei responded.
But at this moment, there was a gentle knock on the door.
After three gentle knocks, he waited quietly outside the door, appearing very polite.
"Who?"
Ji Nanbei frowned slightly and asked Xiao Jingxi in a low voice.
"She must be the maid. It's almost time for the Xianling Sword Sect to have breakfast, so she probably came to invite me to have a meal."
Ji Nanbei was slightly surprised when he heard this.
Xiao Jingxi has reached the peak of his golden elixir, does he still need to eat?
"Breakfast? Shouldn't you have been off grain for a long time?" "Because the ingredients used for breakfast are rare monsters hunted by the elders of the sect, or spiritual plants and animals cultivated by the sect. Eating them is beneficial to the growth of cultivation."
Ji Nanbei secretly clicked his tongue.
This isn't just breakfast, it's obviously to give your disciples money to upgrade!
Damn rich people!
Damn it, tears flowed down from the corners of my mouth unconsciously.
"Come in."
After responding with Xiao Jingxi's cold voice, a woman pushed the door open and entered.
"Miss, it's breakfast time. The sect leader has asked you to go to Taixuan Hall for dinner today, and by the way, meet the master disciple of Qinglian Sword Master."
